set -e

CROSS=mipsel-linux-gnu-
CC=${CROSS}gcc
APP=/app
DG=$APP/doomgeneric/doomgeneric
LIBC=$APP/libc
OBJDIR=$APP/build-mips
OUT=$APP/doomgeneric_mips

GCCINC=$($CC -print-file-name=include)

ARCH="-march=mips2 -mabi=32 -msoft-float -mno-abicalls -fno-pic -G0"
ARCH="$ARCH -mno-check-zero-division -mno-imadd"
OPT="-O2 -fno-strict-aliasing -fno-stack-protector -fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns -fomit-frame-pointer"
INC="-nostdinc -I$LIBC/include -isystem $GCCINC -I$DG"
DEFS="-DNORMALUNIX -DLINUX -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE"
WARN="-w"
CFLAGS="-ffreestanding $ARCH $OPT $INC $DEFS $WARN"

 d_iwad.c d_loop.c d_main.c d_mode.c d_net.c f_finale.c f_wipe.c g_game.c

 w_main.c w_wad.c z_zone.c w_file_stdc.c i_input.c i_video.c doomgeneric.c"

mkdir -p "$OBJDIR"

OBJS=""

$CC $CFLAGS -c "$LIBC/libc.c" -o "$OBJDIR/libc.o"
